speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MOH's vision is for all Singaporeans to live well, live long and with peace of mind.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue to invest in improving the health of Singaporeans and enhancing accessibility, affordability, quality and sustainability of healthcare for Singaporeans, as outlined in our Healthcare 2020 Master Plan introduced in 2012.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We increased the capacity of nursing homes, senior care centres and home care services.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We also introduced new care standards for nursing homes, as well as guidelines for centre-based and home care, to improve the quality of care for our seniors.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We invested in expanding, upgrading and recognising our healthcare workforce to raise the quality of healthcare.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In particular, we worked with the Singapore Institute of Technology to launch new local allied health degree training programmes in Academic Year 2016.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: A CARE (Career, Autonomy, Recognition, Education) package was introduced to boost the nursing profession.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We made healthcare more affordable for lower- to middle-income patients through significant subsidy enhancements for outpatient drugs, subsidised specialist outpatient care, community hospitals and long-term care.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We also allowed more flexibility in the use of Medisave.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Pioneer Generation Package has significantly helped our Pioneers with their medical expenses and given them greater peace of mind with respect to healthcare costs.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: To support successful ageing, we worked with the community to develop holistic health and social programmes and invested in infrastructure to create senior-friendly communities and make ageing a fulfilling journey.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In addition, under the Health Promotion Board (HPB)'s Healthy Living Master Plan, we launched new initiatives, both within the community and at workplaces, to enable Singaporeans to stay fit and healthy.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We faced renewed public health threats from emerging infectious diseases, such as Ebola and MERS, as well as haze, and continued to strengthen our emergency preparedness against these.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MOH's foremost mission is to help Singaporeans stay healthy.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue to invest in Singaporeans' health by enabling citizens to adopt healthy lifestyles in workplaces, schools and the community.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In partnership with other Government agencies, we will step up efforts to reduce obesity and smoking and also work in tandem with Singaporeans to overcome barriers to leading a healthy lifestyle.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Page: 37 We will collaborate with various Government agencies, the people and private sectors, to jointly implement the Action Plan for Successful Ageing.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Action Plan aims to promote active ageing, build a cohesive community with inter-generational harmony and improve our city infrastructure to enable seniors to age confidently in place.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our vision is to achieve "One Singaporean, One Family Doctor", where more Singaporeans will establish a long-term partnership with a regular family doctor.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Over time, the family doctor, being the first stop of care, will develop a more holistic understanding of each family member's health needs.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This will enable them to provide care that is most appropriate for the patient.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue to engage and work closely with the primary care community to strengthen the sector and provide convenient, affordable and good quality care to Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will build on our six Regional Health Systems (RHSes) to reshape healthcare delivery by bringing care beyond hospital walls and integrating preventive, primary, hospital, long-term and home care services.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This is so that patients can receive seamless care that is convenient, appropriate and cost-effective.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The RHSes will strengthen partnerships among public sector, private sector and VWO healthcare providers and also leverage on technology, to provide care that is organised around patients' needs.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will redouble efforts to enhance patient safety and the quality of care in our healthcare system.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The quality of our healthcare system relies on the knowledge and skills of our healthcare professionals.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will embark on efforts to develop a future-ready healthcare workforce by leveraging on SkillsFuture initiatives to strengthen healthcare career pathways.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also continue to recruit and retain healthcare workers and enhance efforts to raise productivity and become leaner in terms of manpower.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In parallel, we will invest in the development of telehealth and robotics to enable us to achieve higher productivity in healthcare and bring better care closer to Singaporeans, while being manpower-efficient.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue to invest in healthcare research to improve care delivery and outcomes.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: As our population ages, we will also need to develop innovative methods to help Singaporeans remain healthy and dynamic even as the average lifespan increases.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also increase primary care capacity through partnerships with GPs and the development of primary care facilities.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also continue to review our financing policies to keep health and aged care affordable for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our plans will enable Singaporeans stay healthy and active throughout their lives.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will have access to high quality care and those of us who need support and assistance will receive them.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Together, Singaporeans will age with confidence and live more fulfilling lives as members of a cohesive and caring Nation for All Ages.
